title: Door lock
access_denied: You do not have access to this door.
definitions_failed: Door definitions could not be loaded.
import_help: Import doors from an ox_doorlock database table
door_retargeted: Door moved to the new target.
categories_description: Optional. A category is a building or group of doors that share settings, like a police station. Doors never need one.
categories_empty: No categories yet. Create one to place doors with shared settings.
category_created: Category created. Set its default settings, then place doors.
category_deleted: Category deleted. Its doors were kept.
category_doors_empty: No doors yet. Press Place doors: the next one will be %{id}.
category_help: Only for keeping doors organised. It never changes who can open the door, and the door ID stays the same.
category_name_help: Doors are called %{id}-1, %{id}-2 ... Renaming the category does not change the IDs of doors already placed.
category_new_help: For example a building: "Mission Row PD". Its doors will be called mission-row-pd-1, mission-row-pd-2 ...
character_dialog_help: This one character can always use the door.
character_exists: That character is already on the door.
characters_empty: No single character is let in by ID.
closest_help: Sort the editor by the closest door.
creator_no_answer: The server did not answer. Restart kora_doorlock so its client and server scripts match, then check the server console.
defaults_note_description: Doors already placed keep what they have. To change one door only, open it from the list above and edit it there.
defaults_note_label: Copied to every door placed from now on
delete_category_body: This removes the category %{name}. Its doors are kept, they just stop being in a category.
delete_door_body: This removes %{name} for good, and unlinks it from any door it is paired with.
doors_description: Pick a door to change it, or create a new one by aiming at it.
doors_empty: No doors yet. Create one to get started.
err_categories_unavailable: Door categories are unavailable. Check the server console.
err_category_limit: There can be at most %{count} categories.
err_db_category: The database refused the category. See the server console.
err_db_door: The database refused the door. See the server console.
err_definition_table: Door definition must be a table.
err_door_gone: That door is no longer configured.
err_door_id_format: Door ID must use letters, numbers, dashes, or underscores.
err_id_in_use: That door ID is already in use.
err_link_failed: Could not save the door link.
err_lockpick_start: The lockpick challenge could not start.
err_no_ox_table: The ox_doorlock table does not exist.
err_no_permission_delete: You do not have permission to delete door locks.
err_no_permission_manage: You do not have permission to manage door locks.
err_no_permission_save: You do not have permission to save door locks.
err_source_gone: The source door is no longer configured.
err_too_far: All selected doors must be within 12 metres of you.
err_unlink_failed: Could not remove the door link.
err_unlink_first: Unlink either door before creating a new pair.
field_autolock_help: The door locks itself this long after it was unlocked. 0 turns it off.
field_distance_help: How close a player must be to use the door, in metres.
field_doorrate_help: Optional. 0 to 10. Leave empty for the game default.
group_dialog_help: Members of this job or gang can use the door from this grade up.
groups_empty: No job or gang can use this door yet.
item_dialog_help: A player holding this item can use the door.
item_type_help: Optional. Only items whose type matches are accepted.
keybind_toggle: Lock or unlock the nearby door
link_help: Linked doors always lock and unlock together.
link_none_free: No other door is free to link with.
link_together: Locks and unlocks together with this door.
lockpick_legacy_help: This door uses an easy/medium/hard list. Saving replaces it with these values.
lockpick_tolerance_help: How forgiving the pins are. 0.03 to 0.35, higher is easier.
new_door_help: You will aim at the door next. You can change everything later.
pair_cancelled: That pair was cancelled. Aim at the first door again, or press Backspace to finish.
passcode_set_help: A passcode is set. Type a new one to replace it, or leave empty to keep it.
pick_link_door: Pick a door to link with.
refresh_failed: The door lock service did not answer.
retarget_double: Aim at a different double door
retarget_single: Aim at a different single door
single_done: Single doors are done for %{category}. Place double doors now?
sound_help: Optional. Leave all four empty for the default sounds.
